name: nutripals
description: NutriPals — an AI nutrition and habit companion (web/PWA monorepo)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @nutripals/core && npm run build -w @nutripals/api-client
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @nutripals/web && npm run build -w @nutripals/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test -w @nutripals/core && npm run test -w @nutripals/server && npm run test -w @nutripals/web
